from collections import Counter
import re
import math
class PFLT:
    def __init__(self):
        self.pul_terms = {
            "bh": "black_hole_collapse", "wh": "white_hole_emission", "trans": "dimensional_transition",
            "exp": "expansion_phase", "neb": "nebula_base", "suc": "suction_effect", "gal": "galaxy_formation",
            "star": "stellar_formation", "hubbk": "71.9 km/s/Mpc", "g": "gauge_coupling", "delta": "perturbation"
        }
        self.fsuit_params = {
            "eta_eff": {"cosmological": 1.0, "white_hole": -2.0, "stellar": 0.5},
            "delta_ph": {"cosmological": 0.0, "white_hole": 0.3, "stellar": 0.1},
            "g": {"stellar": 0.01, "supermassive": 0.1}, "m_pl": 1.22e19
        }
    def preprocess_input(self, input_data, context="cosmological"):
        tokens = re.split(r'\-+', input_data.lower())
        phonemes = [self.pul_terms.get(t, t) for t in tokens]
        return phonemes
    def _modulate_fsuit(self, meaning, phoneme, context, params):
Collapse Wrap Copy

Chapter 4: Validation - Empirical and Cosmic Fit
4.1 Methodology
        eta_eff = params["eta_eff"].get(context, 1.0)
        delta_ph = params["delta_ph"].get(context, 0.0)
        g = params["g"].get("supermassive" if "gal" in meaning else "stellar", 0.01)
        damping = math.exp(-eta_eff) / (params["m_pl"] * 1e-6)
        resonance = 1 + delta_ph + g * 20
        prefix = "resonant_" if resonance > 1.1 else ""
        if damping < 0.95 and eta_eff > 0: prefix += "softened_"
        return f"{prefix}{meaning}"
    def synthesize(self, phonemes, context="cosmological"):
        translation = [self._modulate_fsuit(p, p, context, self.fsuit_params) for p in phonemes]
        return " ".join(translation).capitalize() + "."
    def translate(self, input_data, context="cosmological"):
        phonemes = self.preprocess_input(input_data, context)
        translation = self.synthesize(phonemes, context)
        return {"phonemes": phonemes, "translation": translation}
if __name__ == "__main__":
    pflt = PFLT()
    tests = {
        "supermassive": ["bh-trans-wh-suc-neb-gal"],
        "stellar": ["bh-trans-wh-suc-neb", "neb-exp-star"]
    }
    for ctx, inputs in tests.items():
        for test in inputs:
            result = pflt.translate(test, context="cosmological")
            print(f"{ctx.capitalize()} - Input: {test}")
            print(f"Translation: {result['translation']}")
